name: TallyClip
tagline: Convert bank statement PDFs into clean Excel, CSV, or QuickBooks Online imports
description: TallyClip turns messy bank-statement PDFs into structured Excel/CSV files ready for bookkeeping or QuickBooks Online import. Built for bookkeepers, accountants, and small businesses who waste hours retyping statements. A focused SaaS for converting bank statements into clean, import-ready data—without the spreadsheet grind.
